svg.text: Signed current in both windings; independent of A4988 regulation shunts
34 × 34 mm | 4-layer PCB | Unrouted V2 draft — NOT FOR FABRICATION
TEMP I²C: GPIO4 SDA / GPIO5 SCL. Current: GPIO26 ADC0 / GPIO27 ADC1.
INLINE SHUNTS: A_DRV_PLUS → 50 mΩ → A_PLUS; B_DRV_PLUS → 50 mΩ → B_PLUS.
INA240A1: gain 20 V/V. REF1=3.3 V, REF2=GND. VOUT = 1.65 V + I × 1 V/A.
100 Ω / 10 nF output filters. Kelvin routing and switching-transient checks are required.
V2 ENGINEERING DRAFT — placement, routing, terminal wire fit and CAM not yet qualified.
